segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "CPU" when I talk about my computer project. I say "processor" when I talk about my computer project. I say "process" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use CPU, processor, and process. At the end, I say: I can use CPU clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“CPU、进程与线程”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。CPU：中央处理器，负责执行计算和指令的核心部件。示例：I learned how to use "C P U" in a computer task.processor：处理器，执行程序指令的硬件。示例：I learned how to use "processor" in a computer task.process：进程，正在运行的程序实例。示例：I learned how to use "process" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“合并与冲突”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。merge branches：合并分支，把两条代码线组合起来。示例：Our team uses "merge branches" to keep the project clear.merge conflict：合并冲突，两边修改无法自动组合的情况。示例：Our team uses "merge conflict" to keep the project clear.resolve a conflict：解决冲突，人工决定保留哪些内容。示例：Our team uses "resolve a conflict" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“合并与冲突”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。conflicting change：冲突改动，与另一项修改互不兼容的变化。示例：Our team uses "conflicting change" to keep the project clear.accept incoming change：接受传入改动，选择另一分支的内容。示例：Our team uses "accept incoming change" to keep the project clear.complete the merge：完成合并，解决冲突后创建合并结果。示例：Our team uses "complete the merge" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
